# TestMu AI: Power Your Software Testing with AI and Cloud

> TestMu AI (Formerly LambdaTest) is an Agentic AI Quality Engineering platform that assures AI deployments across the enterprise and the real world. It runs agentic testing for web and mobile apps on 3,000+ browsers and 50,000+ real devices, and for chat, voice, IVR, video, and image agents. It has over 18,000 enterprise customers and over 3 million users spanning 132 countries.(https://www.testmuai.com/)

## How to Block or Allow Pop-Ups in Edge
Microsoft Edge blocks pop-ups by default through a built-in blocker shipped since version 44, found under Settings, Cookies and site permissions, Pop-ups and redirects, or the shortcut edge://settings/content/popups. Turning off the Block toggle allows pop-ups everywhere, while adding a site's URL, with wildcards like [*.]example.com, to the Allow list permits pop-ups only there while keeping the blocker active elsewhere. (https://www.testmuai.com/blog/allow-pop-ups-in-edge/)

## How to Allow Pop-ups in Mozilla Firefox
Mozilla Firefox blocks pop-ups by default, but unchecking the Block pop-up windows checkbox under Settings, Privacy and Security, Permissions allows them for every site, while clicking Exceptions and entering a specific URL allows pop-ups only for that site. The same steps apply on both Windows and macOS, and re-checking the box restores blocking. (https://www.testmuai.com/blog/allow-pop-ups-in-mozilla-firefox/)

## How To Use isDisplayed() In Selenium WebDriver

## How to Use ThreadLocal in Java With Selenium WebDriver
ThreadLocal in Java is a class that gives each thread its own independent copy of a variable, and pairing it with Selenium WebDriver means every parallel test thread gets its own isolated WebDriver instance instead of sharing one. This eliminates cross-thread interference and removes the need for manual synchronization like locks, making parallel Selenium execution safer and more stable. (https://www.testmuai.com/blog/threadlocal-in-java-with-selenium-webdriver/)

## Find Elements With Link Text & Partial Link Text In Selenium
